The middle man has long dark hair, wearing a black t-shirt and ripped light-blue jeans, posing with his hands near his hair. The man on the right wears a black cap, a black leather jacket, and grey trousers, holding his hands to his face in a cute pose. Red text appears at the top, and three labels appear above each person. (2) The scene abruptly shifts to the same three men in a panicked state. The text at the top changes, and several question marks appear as overlays around them, suggesting chaos and disorientation. (3) The men continue to move awkwardly in their panicked poses. The man on the left leans against the wall, while the man on the right looks around as if lost. Subtitles appear at the bottom. (4) The screen transitions to a black background with a single line of red text in the center and three laughing emojis below it.
